taxonomy_note: Initial root-cause lens; reassess final mapping.

controls.source_trace: Read the exact URL parser/client, redirect and retry settings, DNS resolution/connection path, proxy behavior and documented allowed destinations. Identify which bytes the caller can influence.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned allowed endpoint and a separate owned denied endpoint. If redirects are enabled, make the allowed fixture redirect to the denied fixture and correlate a unique application-fetch marker at each hop. For DNS changes, inspect whether the connected address is the one validated; preserve hostname/SNI/certificate verification when evaluating a proposed pinned-address repair.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A public fetch feature or DNS lookup alone is not forbidden HTTP reachability. A callback from the tester's browser is not a server fetch. Absence of a callback without a working allowed control is inconclusive.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Enforce destination policy on actual connections, redirect hops and relevant retries; retain correct TLS peer validation. Retest legitimate fetches and denied callbacks without cloud-metadata or unrelated internal probes.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
